what: The Streamlit front end was replaced by a plain HTML page, served by a small Python server on your own machine.
The page follows your design (design.pdf): each watchlist opens on its Needs review queue, and a trial page shows previous and new values side by side.
All trials, New matches and Summary are tabs of one watchlist. Find trials has its own screen. Renaming or deleting a watchlist, and creating a new one, are small dialogs.
Streamlit, the in-browser runtime and the GitHub Pages site were deleted. It was built in two stages: the feature itself, then a review of the whole change and a round of fixes.
All of it is already merged (pull request #1). You clicked through the app yourself and signed it off on 11 November 2026. This page was made later, as a sample; the build and its issues are real.
so_what: The analyst sees what changed before opening anything, and can review it without losing their place.
When a trial cannot be checked, a saved search fails or the registry cannot be reached, the page says so in a sentence. It does not show a failed result as current.
One failure has no message of its own: with the local server stopped, an action shows the browser's own "Failed to fetch". The build left this issue unfixed.
It runs on your machine only, on a desktop: designed at 1440 pixels wide, working down to 1024. Phones were ruled out in the brief.
The planned work alone did not catch everything: exploratory testing and the code review found issues after it was done, and a re-check after the fixes found more.
now_what: You signed this build off on 11 November 2026, after clicking through the app yourself, and it is merged. Nothing here asks you to accept it again.
This hand-over page and these lists were made on 16 and 17 November 2026, as a sample of the page a future build will give you. The build itself ended on 9 November.
The walk-through was recorded on 16 November 2026, on the code as it stood then, not on the commit the build ended at. The page says which commit.
The log of automated check runs did not exist during this build, so the page cannot say how many runs failed.
The issues listed here are not every issue the build found: 37 come from the old defect log and nine from the build plan's list of follow-ups from exploratory testing.
The code review recorded 62 issues. The 17 it ranked as blocking are here; the other 45 are in its ranked list (.scratch/pr-1-review/ranked.md).
Seven more issues from the review's two later reads have no row here: six from its second read, and one from its re-check of fix ticket 18 (.scratch/pr-1-review/findings/round-1-check.md).
"Blocking" there is the code review's own ranking. No report recorded a severity in the form this page reads, so the page cannot say how serious any issue is.
One exploratory-testing issue can stand for several things the testers reported: the old log cites several reports under one row.
Many issues read "Marked fixed, no test named": the old log names the test that shows a fix only for the issues found at the re-check.
The 17 code-review issues are marked as fixed because each has a finished fix ticket. The review's second read names a test for six of them (.scratch/pr-1-review/findings/round-1.md).
One of those 17 fixes landed with a gap and a new fault: a check still checked a trial removed during that trial's own fetch, and a finished check counted in its total a trial it had skipped.
A later fix (fix ticket 18) closed the wrong count, and closed the gap when the fetch succeeds. When the fetch fails the gap is still open: the fix round deferred it, as item 22 of its choices.
The fix round left a list of 22 choices, each with a recommendation, accepted at sign-off because no objection was raised. The list is in .scratch/pr-1-review/spec.md.
Eleven of the 22 are behind fixes listed on this page (items 1 to 6 and 16 to 20). Of the other eleven, ten were deferred and one was left as it is; item 22 is the gap described above.
The early code review was made before this page's report format existed, so the page found no report from it. Its report is .scratch/html-front-end/reviews/01-foundation.md.
